description: Search EPA-regulated facilities by state, city, zip, and/or facility name. Returns each facility's Registry ID (needed for the other EPA tools), address, and a snapshot of its compliance status across Clean Air Act, Clean Water Act, RCRA (waste), and Safe Drinking Water programs. Provide at least one filter; broad queries (e.g. state only for a large state) may be rejected as too broad, so add a city, zip, or name.

active_only.description: If true, only return facilities flagged with active enforcement/compliance activity.

name: epa_facility_search
